quest.title: Rebuild the K-row
quest.description: Reconstruct the row, then retrieve every sound from memory.

row.title: K-row
row.note: Five sound–character relationships: ka, ki, ku, ke, ko.

scoring.notes: XP is session feedback only, not proof of mastery. First-try scores reward accurate unassisted responses.

source_note: Based on the user's October 2026 documented base-hiragana experiment: sound framework, scrambled-tile reconstruction, active retrieval and writing production. This prototype tests one row and two connected reps; handwritten production and delayed retention are not yet implemented.
